A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CymbaDiff and SketchSem3D. Their main text, five figures, seven tables, equations, checklist, and Appendices A.1–A.8 are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original scene-generation, ablation, and semantic-completion results in Section 5, plus VAE reconstruction, efficiency, and adapted-baseline experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the generation and completion experiments and the supplementary experiments in Tables 5–7.

M1.justification: The architecture, cylinder/Triple Mamba processing, conditioning, and training objectives remain unchanged. Figure 2 relabels reconstruction blocks from Encoder to Decoder, agreeing with the decoder description already present in v1 Section 4.2.

E1.justification: Both retain Sketch-based SemanticKITTI and KITTI-360 generation and transfer evaluation, plus SemanticKITTI completion. Figure 1 updates an illustrative GPS label without establishing any change in training or evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2, 4, 6, and 7. This includes SSD, Semcity, 3D Latent Diffusion, 3D DiT, the completion baselines, and the adapted SemCity and CityDreamer denoisers already evaluated in v1 Appendix A.6.

E3.justification: The reported splits, resolutions, metrics, training budgets, and 100 denoising steps are unchanged. Both use the same KITTI-360 transfer protocol without fine-tuning and evaluate the 16 overlapping classes.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same CSCB, DDCB, and C-Mamba ablations. Cross-dataset robustness evaluation and generation-diversity examples are also retained; Figure 4 reformats existing examples rather than adding an analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Both explicitly answer No to statistical-significance reporting in checklist item 7.

E6.justification: All numerical results in Tables 2–7 are unchanged, including CymbaDiff FID values of 40.67 and 107.53 and completion scores of 43.2% IoU and 14.6% mIoU. Figures 4–5 retain the same generated scenes and qualitative findings.

T1.justification: The state-space and Mamba formulations, training objectives, and metric definitions in Equations 1–10 are unchanged. Neither version adds theoretical assumptions, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about the novel sketch-conditioned outdoor generation task, SketchSem3D benchmark, spatially coherent CymbaDiff model, and generation, completion, and generalization performance.

C2.justification: Both retain the same mechanism explanations and qualifications concerning temporal sketch/PSA mismatch, noisy annotations, small or occluded objects, and the absence of authentic human-drawn sketches. Appendix A.6's explanation of baseline weaknesses is also unchanged.

D1.justification: Dataset construction instructions, architecture details, Appendix A.3 hardware and hyperparameters, code/data access statements, and Appendix A.8 licenses remain unchanged. The corrected diagram labels add no implementation information beyond the existing text.

R1.justification: v3 removes 15 distinct bibliography entries unused in the main text or appendices, including Skip Mamba Diffusion, V-Net, and LMSCNet. All works actually cited in the discussion remain, so this is limited bibliographic pruning without substantive repositioning.

P1.justification: The bibliography switches from author initials and quoted titles to full names and a different reference style, with reordered and renumbered citations. The main prose, section sequence, and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 updates its example GPS coordinates; Figure 2 corrects two Encoder labels to Decoder; Figure 4 boxes and realigns the sketch thumbnails and adjusts image sizing. Tables and references undergo limited typesetting changes, with no new figures or tables.

improvement.justification: Figure 2 resolves misleading reconstruction-block labels by matching the existing decoder description, while Figure 4 makes the conditioning sketches easier to distinguish. These provide limited accuracy and readability gains; the scientific evidence, experimental rigor, and reproducibility disclosures remain unchanged.
